title: Nilipata kibandiko cha kuuliza swali ambalo liligeuka kuwa kosa

text.I got a sticker for asking a question th: Nilipata kibandiko cha kuuliza swali ambalo liligeuka kuwa kosa
text.My company has a system called thank-you: Kampuni yangu ina mfumo unaoitwa vibandiko vya shukrani, na 10 kati yao zikirundikana, huwa 1000 kadi ya yen ya Amazon.
text.There was too much I did not know, so I: Kulikuwa na mengi ambayo sikujua, kwa hivyo sikuelewa chochote. Kwa hivyo niliendelea kuwauliza wazee wangu kila kitu.
text.Then sometimes, the thing I asked as a q: Kisha wakati mwingine, jambo nililouliza kama swali lilikuwa ni kosa.
text.There are things I do not understand, an: Kuna vitu sielewi, na nauliza wazee wangu nikidhani watajua, lakini wakati mwingine ni mbaya sana, na ni makosa ambayo husababisha tukio. Wakati kama huo, inaweza kugeuka kuwa "kupanda nzuri".
text.Something I asked as a question ended up: Kitu nilichouliza kama swali kiliishia kuwa ongezeko, na mchezo mzuri wa bahati ukazaliwa, na vibandiko vilirundikana.
text.When someone said “nice escalation” to m: Wakati mtu aliniambia "kupanda nzuri" kwangu, nilifurahi.
text.Stickers with “nice escalation” written: Vibandiko vya vilivyoandikwa "kupanda vizuri" viliendelea kuongezeka, na nilifurahi kidogo.
text.I cannot talk and think at the same time: siwezi kuzungumza na kufikiria kwa wakati mmoja, kwa hivyo natuma gumzo kwanza
text.Before I go home, I open tomorrow's manu: Kabla sijaenda nyumbani, ninafungua miongozo ya kesho
